narration: If you are opening Propeller for the first time, here is the full player-prop research workflow in the order that matters.
visual_required: Open on the current public Prop Analyzer with a concise title overlay.
crop_or_focus: Move from the current analyzer title into the research workflow label.
notes: Current public capture dated 2026-07-21; the live public feed was empty and will be shown honestly.

narration: Start with the exact question in front of you: the player, stat, direction, and current line.
visual_required: Show the same illustrative historical prop on desktop and mobile, then isolate the line and direction.
crop_or_focus: Sequential zoom/callouts: player, stat, side, line 0.5.
notes: Persistent corner label: Illustrative historical capture · July 2026. Desktop and mobile use the same historical example.

narration: Read confidence correctly: it summarizes directional evidence, not an exact chance of hitting.
visual_required: Show desktop confidence then the mobile confidence presentation for the same illustrative prop.
crop_or_focus: Zoom to confidence 79; later show the distinct chance-to-hit field in Model Read while explaining it is separate.
notes: Persistent historical-capture label. Keep separate confidence and chance-to-hit values legible, never conflated.

narration: The agent breakdown shows supporting signals, conflict, and the top driver.
visual_required: Show actual desktop model breakdown and the corresponding mobile Model Read/Agent Breakdown.
crop_or_focus: Highlight available historical agents and mobile agreement/top-driver cards. Use a pass label when evidence is mixed.
notes: Persistent historical-capture label; no fabricated agent disagreement or current data claims.

narration: Check the line and context that can change; a changed line is a new research question.
visual_required: Show the actual current public analyzer with a clearly labelled no-current-props state card.
crop_or_focus: Current-state empty-board card; no mobile equivalent is used because the current mobile app had an empty slate but did not expose a public prop-detail equivalent.
notes: Current live public feed showed no rows on 2026-07-21. The editorial card quotes that truthful state and avoids mixing it with historical UI.

narration: Repeat: confirm, interpret, inspect, recheck, then research further or pass.
visual_required: Replay the historical desktop flow with compact step labels, using mobile as a supporting device frame.
crop_or_focus: Five-step guided montage with an explicit Pass outcome.
notes: Continuous camera movement across relevant screens; no checklist-only slide.

narration: Explore the current Prop Analyzer; Propeller is research and analytics, not a sportsbook.
visual_required: End on current public analyzer, then a restrained branded end card with disclaimer.
crop_or_focus: CTA URL and responsible-use language inside safe area.
notes: No product claims beyond the verified workflow. Current mobile app screen is a genuine empty-slate capture.
